name: Haus Gertrud
beschreibung:
The Hotel Haus Gertrud is located in the municipality of Nesselwängle in the Tannheimer Tal in Tirol.

Its location on the edge of the village offers an unobstructed view of the surrounding mountain world of the Allgäuer Alpen.

The rooms are equipped with a balcony or terrace, local woods, and a modern bathroom.

Breakfast is served as a buffet with regional products; in the evening there is a set menu.

Hiking and cycling trails start directly at the house.

In winter, the house is located on the cross-country ski trail and near the mountain railway to the Tannheimer Tal ski area.

The family-run management and the use of local materials define the quiet atmosphere of the house.
